ns0:section.ns0:heading: Unauthorized access to intelligence community property

ns0:subsection.ns0:heading: Prohibited Activity.—
ns0:subsection.ns0:chapeau: It shall be unlawful, within the jurisdiction of the United States, without authorization to willfully go upon any property—

ns0:paragraph.ns0:content: with intent to gather intelligence or information to the detriment of the United States; and

ns0:paragraph.ns0:chapeau: while knowing that such property is—

ns0:subparagraph.ns0:content: under the jurisdiction of an element of the intelligence community (as defined in section 3(4) of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 3003(4)); and

ns0:subsection.ns0:heading: Penalties.—
ns0:subsection.ns0:chapeau: Any person who violates subsection (a) shall—

ns0:paragraph.ns0:content: in the case of the first offense, be fined under section 3571 of this title, imprisoned not more than 6 months, or both;
in the case of a second offense after a prior conviction under subsection (a) has become final, be fined under this title, imprisoned not more than 2 years, or both; and
in the case of a third or subsequent offense after a prior conviction under subsection (a) has become final, be fined under this title, imprisoned not more than 5 years, or both.

ns0:section.ns0:sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 119–60, div. F, title LXIII, § 6304, Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1611.)
